title: CoreWeave's ~$9B all-stock bid for Core Scientific (voted down)

sources.quote: As of July 3, 2025, the agreed-upon exchange ratio implies a total equity value of approximately $9.0 billion.
On October 30, 2025, pursuant to and in accordance with the merger agreement, Core Scientific terminated the merger agreement with CoreWeave, effective immediately.

explain: CoreWeave agreed to buy its landlord Core Scientific with its own shares, valued at about $9 billion. Core Scientific shareholders voted it down in October 2025 and the deal was terminated, so no money changed hands.
